title: Residual Stochastic Concept Bottleneck Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.23421v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Concept-based models (CMs) learn human-interpretable intermediate representations that enable users to understand the model's reasoning and steer its predictions through test-time concept interventions. However, in realistic settings, their performance can be limited by concept incompleteness, where the training concepts fail to capture all task-relevant information. Adding an unconstrained residual pathway to the model's predictive process can overcome the consequences of incompleteness. However, this introduces an inscrutable, leak-prone prediction pathway that may weaken concept interventions, as these often leave residual variables unchanged. To address this limitation, we introduce Residual Stochastic Concept Bottleneck Models (Res-SCBMs), a family of concept-based models that jointly model concept and residual variables through a multivariate Gaussian distribution. translated_title: 残差随机概念瓶颈模型
translated_abstract: 基于概念的模型（CMs）学习人类可解释的中间表示，使用户能够理解模型的推理过程，并通过测试时的概念干预来引导其预测。然而，在现实场景中，其性能可能受限于概念不完备性，即训练概念未能捕获所有与任务相关的信息。在模型的预测过程中添加一条不受约束的残差路径可以克服不完备性带来的影响，但这会引入一条难以解释且易于信息泄露的预测通道，可能削弱概念干预的效果，因为概念干预通常不会改变残差变量。为解决这一局限，我们提出了残差随机概念瓶颈模型，这是一族通过多元高斯分布联合建模概念变量与残差变量的基于概念的模型。Res-SCBMs 学习一种协方差结构，显式地捕获（概念与残差之间的）依赖关系。
tldr: 提出残差随机概念瓶颈模型，通过多元高斯分布联合建模概念与残差变量并学习其协方差依赖结构，在缓解概念不完备问题的同时避免无约束残差路径削弱概念干预的有效性。
en_tdlr: Residual Stochastic Concept Bottleneck Models (Res-SCBMs) jointly model concepts and residuals via a multivariate Gaussian with learned covariance structure, mitigating concept incompleteness while preserving the effectiveness of concept interventions.
